subject.title: WhatsApp QR-unavailable/headless login needs phone-code fallback

question: Should WhatsApp phone-code login be exposed through a generic channel login method/CLI flag, or kept behind a WhatsApp-owned auth surface?
rationale: Current main lacks the capability, but adding it changes public CLI/channel-auth surface and persisted auth-session behavior, so maintainer intent is needed before treating either open PR as the final shape.

options.title: Land a reviewed typed seam
options.body: Choose one open PR or a replacement, keep QR as default, require live pairing proof, and merge once auth/session compatibility risks are addressed.

options.title: Keep the API WhatsApp-local
options.body: Decline the generic channel login seam and ask for a WhatsApp-owned CLI/tool entrypoint if shared channel auth should remain QR-only.

options.title: Defer phone-code support
options.body: Leave QR-only behavior documented and close or pause the candidate PRs if maintainers decide the product/API risk outweighs demand.

recommendation.title: Land a reviewed typed seam
recommendation.body: Choose one open PR or a replacement, keep QR as default, require live pairing proof, and merge once auth/session compatibility risks are addressed.

likelyOwner.reason: They have recent WhatsApp auth/session history and authored the current replacement implementation PR.
